tool.name: TrainModel
tool.description: : Trains a PyTorch autoencoder using the given properties.

param.name: input_model_pth_path
param.label: input PTH file
param.help: Path to the input model file. Format: [input].pth

param.name: input_dataset_pt_path
param.label: input PT file
param.help: Path to the input dataset file (.pt) produced by the MD feature pipeline. Format: [input].pt

param.name: outname_output_model_pth_path
param.label: output PTH name
param.help: Path to save the trained model (.pth). If omitted, the trained model is only available in memory Format: [output].pth

param.name: outname_output_metrics_npz_path
param.label: output NPZ name
param.help: Path save training metrics in compressed NumPy format (.npz) Format: [output].npz

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: Trainer
param.label: Trainer
param.help: PyTorch Lightning Trainer options (e.g. max_epochs, callbacks, logger, profiler, accelerator, devices, etc.). (Json)

param.name: Dataset
param.label: Dataset
param.help: mlcolvar DictDataset / DictModule options (e.g. batch_size, split proportions and shuffling flags). (Json)
